verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover all three parts of the story. AI 'suggested summaries' target responders who lack time to digest information and communicate (docs-53). 'Suggestions' automatically drafts updates, summaries and follow-up actions from incident activity (docs-54). Scribe transcribes incident calls (docs-55, docs-30). Missing for 10: detail on how Scribe turns transcripts into structured call notes (its evidence comes mainly from troubleshooting pages), explicit confirmation that summaries update live as the incident unfolds, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
